questions.question: The average weight of 5 men is decreased by 3 kg when one of them weighing 150 kg is replaced by another person. This new person is again replaced by another person whose weight is 30 kg lower than the person he replaced. What is the overall change in the average due to this dual change?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Initial average weight of 5 men decreases by 3 kg when one man (weighing 150 kg) is replaced.

New person is replaced by another person whose weight is 30 kg lower.

**Formula Used:**

Average weight change = Total change in weight / Number of men

**Calculation:**

Decrease in average when 150 kg man is replaced:

⇒ Total decrease = 3 kg × 5 men = 15 kg

⇒ New man's weight = 150 kg - 15 kg = 135 kg

New person (135 kg) is replaced by someone 30 kg lighter:

⇒ Replacement person's weight = 135 kg - 30 kg = 105 kg

Total weight change due to the dual change:

⇒ Total change = 150 kg - 105 kg = 45 kg

Overall change in the average:

⇒ Overall change in average = Total change / Number of men

⇒ Overall change in average = 45 kg / 5 men

⇒ Overall change in average = 9 kg

**∴ The overall change in the average weight is 9 kg.**

questions.question: What provides the centripetal force for the motion of the moon around the earth?

options.text: Force exerted by the atoms of non-living things on earth
Force of attraction of the earth

questions.solution:
The correct answer is "**Force of attraction of the earth**". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gravity **is the phrase used to describe the **attraction force** that the **earth exerts **on any object. Gravity is a force that all **objects** are **drawn to**.
 
• **Satellites **can **orbit **a body and fall around it rather than into it if the speed and** gravity** are just right.
 
• The **centripetal force** required to keep planets in orbit around the Sun and all kinds of satellites in orbit** around** the **Earth** is provided by **gravitational attraction.**
 
• The **Moon** continues to** orbit** the **Earth** because of **gravity**. The velocity of the Moon is continuously shifting in one direction.
 
• *Therefore, the force of attraction of the earth provides the centripetal force for the motion of the moon around the earth.​​*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A "**centripetal**" force is the name given to the **ongoing pull** on the Moon as it revolves around the Earth. The "**centrifugal" force**, which pulls on the Earth and keeps the moon in motion,** balances** this force.
 
• Any force that induces a **shift in velocity** direction toward the** center** of a **circular motion** is referred to as a** centripetal force.** Centripetal force is caused by the part of the force that is **perpendicular** to the velocity.
 
• This force causes a body to travel along a** curved route**. It always moves in the opposite direction of the body's motion and in the direction of the **immediate center** of the path's curvature.

questions.question: Which of the following do not contain any enzymes?
questions.solution:
__**Concept**__** :**

__
 
• The process of digestion includes both** mechanical** and** chemical** processes.
 
• Mechanical digestion includes churning or **mastication of food.**
 
• The chemical process includes the action of** certain enzymes** which break down the food and convert it into simpler forms.

**Explanation__ :**

**Bile juice:**

__
 
• The bile secreted by the **hepatic cells **passes through the hepatic ducts and is stored and concentrated in a thin muscular sac called the** gall bladder. **
 
• It **does not **contain any enzyme.
 
• Bile helps in the emulsification of fats, i.e., **breaking down the fats into very small micelles.** Bile also activates lipases.

**Pancreatic juice:**

 
• The **exocrine portion** of the pancreas secretes an **alkaline pancreatic juice containing enzymes **and the endocrine portion secretes hormones, insulin, and glucagon. 
 
• The pancreatic juice contains inactive enzymes – trypsinogen, chymotrypsinogen, procarboxypeptidases, amylases, lipases, and nucleases.

**Salivary juice:**

 
• The saliva secreted into the oral cavity contains electrolytes and enzymes,** salivary amylase**, and lysozyme.
 
• The chemical process of digestion is initiated in the oral cavity by the hydrolytic action of the carbohydrate-splitting enzyme, the salivary amylase.

**Gastric juice:**

 
• **Rennin** is a proteolytic enzyme found in the gastric juice of infants which helps in the digestion of milk proteins.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Trypsinogen** is activated by an enzyme, enterokinase, secreted by the intestinal mucosa into active trypsin, which in turn **activates** the other enzymes in the pancreatic juice.
 
• The bile released into the duodenum contains bile pigments **(bilirubin and biliverdin)**, bile salts, cholesterol, and phospholipids.

• In an aquatic ecosystem such as **ponds**, the **biomass pyramid** is often **inverted**.
 
• This means that the biomass of **primary producers** (phytoplankton) is **less** than the biomass of **primary consumers** (zooplankton).
 
• Phytoplankton have a **high turnover rate** which means they are quickly consumed by zooplankton, leading to a lower biomass at any given time.
 
• Zooplankton have a **longer lifespan** and a higher biomass as they feed on phytoplankton.
 
• This inversion is unique to certain aquatic ecosystems and does not typically occur in terrestrial ecosystems.

 __
 
• In **drylands** ecosystems, the biomass pyramid is typically **upright**.
 
• This is due to the **low productivity** and **slow turnover rates** of vegetation.
 
• **Primary producers** such as grasses and shrubs have a higher biomass compared to primary consumers.
 
 
 
• **Forest**__
 __
 
• In **forest** ecosystems, the biomass pyramid is generally **upright**.
 
• Forests have a large biomass of **primary producers** (trees) compared to primary consumers.
 
• Trees have a **long lifespan** and accumulate significant biomass over time.
 
 
 
• **Grassland**__
 
 
• In **grassland** ecosystems, the biomass pyramid is also **upright**.
 
• Primary producers like **grasses** have a higher biomass than primary consumers.
